cases.name: free-preview tier returns 200 without a payment token

_notes: This example does NOT enable the proxy admin listener, so
/healthz (which lives on the admin port, default 9090) is not
reachable. The data plane's built-in liveness path is /health,
served by every sbproxy instance regardless of admin config; we
use that as the smoke runner's liveness probe.
The feature check needs cases[] rather than feature_endpoints[]
because the origin is keyed on Host: blog.localhost, not the bare
127.0.0.1 the runner's plain GET would send; feature_endpoints[]
has no way to set a request header. Only the free-preview tier
returns 200 without a payment token, so it is the only path safe
to assert on without also threading a crawler-payment token
audit_check stays false until Wave 2 (R1.2) ships the OSS
